vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE-2026-27315 is PUBLISHED and identifies cleartext persistence of password-bearing cqlsh commands in ~/.cassandra/cqlsh_history. In both cassandra-4.0.0 and cassandra-4.0.19, bin/cqlsh.py defines that history path and save_history() unconditionally reaches readline.write_history_file(HISTORY); LOGIN accepts an inline password.

atomic_bic.evidence: A full-clone reverse -Swrite_history_file history on bin/cqlsh and bin/cqlsh.py first reaches CASSANDRA-3188. Its patch creates bin/cqlsh with HISTORY=~/.cqlsh_history and the unconditional readline.write_history_file(HISTORY) sink. Later save_history extraction, history-path relocation, and bin/cqlsh-to-bin/cqlsh.py rename do not first-write the sink.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: rev-list reports exactly this one parent; its tree has neither bin/cqlsh nor bin/cqlsh.py, and git grep finds no write_history_file under bin.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC is a single-parent 2011 git-svn commit that directly creates the vulnerable file. It is not a merge or later aggregate; no finer public member exists in the clone, so squash decomposition is not applicable.

affected_release_membership.evidence: The BIC is an ancestor of cassandra-4.0-alpha1 and cassandra-4.0.0. The unguarded sink is present in the resolved cassandra-4.0.0 and cassandra-4.0.19 tag trees, matching the vendor/CVE affected range 4.0 through 4.0.19.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: b47179b7d4fc078cebe0ef8cc3ea83d2ec685ee8 is not an ancestor of cassandra-4.0.19 but is an ancestor of cassandra-4.0.20; CHANGES.txt in the patch records the CASSANDRA-21180 history-disable option. It is also contained in the vendor-listed 4.1.11, 5.0.7, and 6.0-alpha1 tags.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: The fix adds --disable-history and cqlshrc [history] disabled, threads disable_history into Shell/main, warns that history may contain passwords, and gates save_history(). Its immediate parent 2ce273a11864630ecae78869e7f5f7229cfc1ada still calls readline.write_history_file(HISTORY) without that gate.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The exact BIC object is dated 2011-11-07, names Jonathan Ellis as author and committer, credits a patch by Paul Cannon reviewed by jbellis, and carries git-svn-id metadata. It has no AI/bot identity or Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor marker. Fix-side 2026 co-author trailers were excluded from attribution.

findings: The primary record's mechanism, atomic BIC, immediate parent, direct fix, release topology, and NOT_AI attribution independently reproduce from the permitted advisory and local full clone.
The clone is non-shallow with a resolvable HEAD and packed object history; all cited commits and tags resolve to full objects.
No corrected primary field is required.
